title.zh: 授权菲律宾总统向美国政府及其机构与机关借入必要贷款或承担必要债务，以弥补菲律宾共和国政府用于重建及其他用途的预算赤字与其他支出，并为此拨付必要资金的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the President of the Philippines to obtain such loans or incur such indebtedness with the Government of the United States, its Agencies and Instrumentalities, as may be necessary to cover budgetary deficits and other expenditures of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines for rehabilitation and other purposes, and appropriating the necessary funds therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép Tổng thống Philippines vay hoặc gánh nợ từ Chính phủ Hoa Kỳ, các cơ quan và tổ chức trực thuộc nhằm bù đắp thâm hụt ngân sách và chi tiêu khác của Chính phủ Cộng hòa Philippines cho công tác tái thiết và mục đích khác
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้อำนาจประธานาธิบดีฟิลิปปินส์กู้ยืมหรือก่อหนี้กับรัฐบาลสหรัฐอเมริกาและหน่วยงานหรือองค์กรในความควบคุมของรัฐบาลสหรัฐอเมริกาเพื่อชดเชยภาวะขาดดุลงบประมาณและรายจ่ายอื่นๆ ของรัฐบาลสาธารณรัฐฟิลิปปินส์สำหรับการฟื้นฟูและวัตถุประสงค์อื่น
title.id: Undang-Undang memberi wewenang kepada Presiden Filipina untuk memperoleh pinjaman atau menanggung utang dari Pemerintah Amerika Serikat, lembaga-lembaganya dan badan-badan pelaksananya sebagaimana diperlukan untuk menutupi defisit anggaran dan pengeluaran lain pemerintah Republik Filipina bagi rehabilitasi dan tujuan lain
title.ms: Akta memberi kuasa kepada Presiden Filipina untuk mendapatkan pinjaman atau menanggung hutang dengan kerajaan Amerika Syarikat, agensi dan badan-badannya sebagaimana diperlukan untuk menampung defisit peruntukan dan perbelanjaan lain kerajaan Republik Filipina bagi pemulihan dan tujuan lain

text.en: The President of the Philippines is hereby authorized to negotiate such loans or to incur such indebtedness with the Government of the United States, its agencies and instrumentalities, as may be necessary to cover budgetary deficits and other expenditures of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines for rehabilitation purposes, including the purchase of necessary equipment or of surplus and other kinds of property from the United States, under such terms and conditions as may be agreed upon.

The authority herein granted to the President shall be deemed to include the authority to guarantee loans and credits extended to the corporations owned or controlled by the Government of the Republic of the Philippines.

It shall be the duty of the President as soon as a loan is obtained or an indebtedness is incurred, to report to the Congress the amount of loan obtained and to submit a detailed program of expenditures for its approval.

The necessary amount is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated to pay the principal and interest on such loan or indebtedness as and when they shall become due.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: September 18, 1946
